snippet.title: Solvimus - A Co-Op Puzzle Solving Game | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/solvimus-cefe71
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3980290/Solvimus
Xbox: T.B.D. 2026
PlayStation:  https://store.playstation.com/de-ch/concept/10017868

Do you like bad jokes, hard puzzles, and have exactly one friend? Get ready to lose that one too.

Solvimus is a two-player co-op puzzle game with 30 challenging levels that will test your patience, your problem-solving skills, and possibly your friendship.

#gaming #coop #puzzlegame #solvimus
